Owen —

Short roast + the launch pack you asked for.

What to change first
- Above the fold, lead with a visitor‑centred line and one action. Suggestion: “Bristol‑made solid wood furniture.” Sub: “Free 2‑man delivery over £500. Nearly 2,000 reviews. Klarna available.” Primary CTA: pick one (Build yours or Get free swatches).

Where to send paid traffic
- One ad, one promise, one page. Build a single‑offer landing page per campaign; avoid sending ads to the homepage.

Black Friday quick wins
- Replace the 5‑field early‑access gate with email‑only. Show the code instantly on confirmation and keep it visible on the offer page and through checkout.

Canvas launch test stacks (pasteable section orders)
- Value‑led stack: value line + delivery/reviews → bestsellers → FAQs → CTA.
- Problem–solution stack: flat‑pack pain → solid‑wood craft → workshop proof → reviews → CTA.
- Offer + UGC stack: seasonal offer bar + hero → review tiles → workshop clip/photo → trust badges → CTA.

The creative rule that keeps costs in check
- Retire creative after about three weeks of falling click‑through; ship each concept in at least three variants so the account can learn.

If you want this turned into a runnable launch test plan with page wires, say so and Priya Nair will be in touch.
